name: Rollins, Inc.
summary: Rollins, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides pest and wildlife control services and protection to residential and commercial customers in the United States and internationally. The company offers pest control services to residential properties protecting from common pests, including rodents, insects, and wildlife. It also provides workplace pest control solutions for customers across various
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 7/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 74/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 35/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 41.03 USD (+8 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
